name: wealthsimple-roi-analyzer
description: Chrome extension for advanced ROI graphs on Wealthsimple accounts

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp manifest.json background.js popup.html popup.css popup.js wealthsimple_api.js country_exposure.js LICENSE NOTICE dist/ && cp -R icons dist/ && cp node_modules/chart.js/dist/chart.umd.js dist/chart.js
scripts.package: npm run build && cd dist && zip -r ../wealthsimple-roi-analyzer.zip .
